The '''Cliffhold meeting hall''' was a building in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. The hall was the meeting place for the [[Iego council/Legends|Iego council]], an organization that governed Cliffhold. During their [[Mission to Iego/Legends|mission]] to recover [[Reeksa/Legends|Reeksa]] root, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] met with the Iego council in the meeting hall to convince them that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was being guarded by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]], not the malevolent [[Deity/Legends|deity]] known as [[Drol/Legends|Drol]].
